project.description: Angular application in angular.json or an Nx project.json to configure. Required when multiple apps exist.

sourceLocale.description: Optional override for the source locale; otherwise discovered from project i18n.sourceLocale (fallback en-US).

locales.description: Optional override for target locales; otherwise discovered from project i18n.locales and messages.<locale>.json catalogs in the selected app.

queryParam.description: URL query parameter used to select the locale.

projects.description: Angular applications to configure. Otherwise choose interactively.

all.description: Configure every supported Angular application without prompting.
